attchmntText: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit after tax of 59,317.91 lakhs. Revenue from operations stood at 270,260.42 lakhs. The company recognized an exceptional item provision of 11,629.85 lakhs related to a GSTAT order concerning Rail Neer profiteering. The basic earnings per share was 7.41 rupees. The company noted a compliance issue regarding the number of Independent Directors on its Board.

attchmntText: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Board Comments on fines levied by the Exchanges for non-compliances of certain Regulations of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
sm_name: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited
